compiled_kernel_resources.scope: Static compiler declarations, not measured occupancy.

implementation: Retain the original macro producer, conditional native2^-19 envelope and complete staged2 replay unchanged. Add a coalesced metadata implementation in which each wave owns one row/block and neighboring lanes load contiguous original BF16 words. Each lane scans at most32 terms, then five shuffle reductions sum squares, maximize original magnitudes and propagate unsupported flags. Compare F64 and F32 sums. BF16 products are exact in both formats within the admitted domain, with no square/sum underflow or overflow. The F32 positive-sum gamma37 relative bound is below2.3ppm. The existing20ppm norm inflation covers sum, square root, conversion and multiplication. Metadata remains eight bytes per row/block. Original per-thread F64 controls are kept for every block size.
correctness_scope: The complete local suite reruns the original macro-bound tests and independent canonical checks. New sanitized metadata tests enumerate all65536 BF16 encodings in three row contexts, plus every length1..1024 in eight distributions covering zero, wide exponent spreads, concentrated maxima and unsupported words; both F64 and F32 reductions must bound independent F64 original squares and match exact maxima. Every GPU metadata entry is independently checked for conservativeness and maximum correctness; metadata remains immutable after preparation in separate audited runs. All original generated/captured output, candidate permutation, selected raw endpoint, interval, source/prepared word, unused capacity and guard checks run for all13 configurations. The original complete canonical GPU outputs are GB10 checked, and sampled complete dots are CPU checked. References remain comparison inputs only. Finite data do not prove the native WMMA error coefficient universally.
timing_scope: Thirteen owners comprise the C64/full replay control plus Groups8/16/32/64 with each of per-thread F64, cooperative F64 and cooperative F32 metadata. One warmup and three measured samples rotate whole-operator order by five positions. Include original lossless row preparation, eligibility, complete norm metadata generation, producer, selection, count read and all selected replay. Allocation, clearing, canonical/CPU reference computation, validation and separate audits are outside clocks. Audited phase arrays separately measure completed original preparation/eligibility, metadata, producer, selection/count read and replay; each phase has explicit completion and the metadata readback/check is excluded. These single-launch audited stage observations are diagnostic and do not sum to or replace the production clock. All variants preallocate maximum metadata capacity. Captured q8192 repeats1023 rows of q7169 and is not a token loop. QKV C64 is a slower control than the retained matrix producer.

decision.reason: Coalesced FP32 metadata removes most of the preparation penalty and all13 configurations pass GB10 component checks. Best completed OUT still regresses21.0747ms and C64 QKV24.3769ms. Audited K128 metadata falls6.5910 to0.6451ms for OUT and4.5101 to0.5191ms for QKV; the unchanged macro producer and selected replay remain dominant. All candidate counts match across the three metadata methods at a fixed block size. Do not integrate this route or extrapolate to TTFT.
decision.next_measured_question: Evaluate a single whole-dot envelope with only native partial sum and maximum live through K, removing repeated block envelopes and their center/error state. Compare the additional complete canonical replay required by the wider interval; retain the native error condition and GB10 boundary.
